name: Demon's Lament
source:
You are summoned by a priest, but what purpose will you serve, and can you win back your freedom?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

你被一名神父召唤到了现世——他究竟打算让你发挥何种用处？你又能否重新赢回属于自己的自由？
